units.name: ResetPpuScrollLatch

units.name: UploadSixteenColors

units.name: ReadControllers
units.summary: Strobe both ports, preserve held states and derive newly pressed bits. Mask Start/Select from port 2 and merge its remaining held bits into the main input.

units.name: ReadControllerPort
units.summary: Read eight serial bits from port X. Accept either low hardware bit and rotate into A; save the packed result in the controller array.

units.name: SetPpuControl
units.summary: Write A to PPUCTRL and its software shadow together.

units.name: IrqReturn
